newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 100 head slaughter steers and 100 heifers; 400 head confirmed for the week to date. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1175 lbs 64.00 North Plains. Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 63.00.
Confirmed - 200 Week Ago - None Year Ago - None
Wk to Date - 400 Week Ago - 2,800 Year Ago - 100
